Campaign Moodboard
The visual direction for this campaign focuses on energetic matchday culture, digital fan interaction, and community-driven sports identity.
Visual themes explored:

Stadium atmosphere and fan emotion

Digital-first content aesthetics

Youth culture and streetwear influence

Bold typography and motion-driven visuals

Social media storytelling formats

This moodboard supports the development of immersive brand experiences that resonate with Gen Z audiences.


Strategic Focus

Expand digital matchday engagement

Strengthen brand community identity

Increase experiential value of live events

Build peer-driven brand advocacy




Activation Ideas
Digital Social Challenge
Interactive matchday challenges encouraging fan-generated content.
Influencer Matchday Takeovers
Local Gen Z creators documenting real fan experiences.
Limited Edition Drops
Timed merchandise releases to create urgency and exclusivity.
In-Stadium Digital Participation
Real-time interactive content moments during matches.



Audience Persona
Name: Jordan, 21
Profile: College student, highly social media active
Motivation: Community belonging + entertainment experiences
Behavior: Engages with sports primarily through digital platforms
Opportunity: Deliver immersive and shareable brand moments



Projected Campaign Impact

+28% projected increase in Gen Z social engagement

+18% projected growth in matchday interest

+22% improvement in digital brand interaction




Strategic Takeaway
Modern sports marketing success depends on creating participatory experiences that extend beyond live events into digital community spaces.

title: Dashboard
text:
This dashboard shows my ability to organize data, create visual summaries, and communicate insights in a clear way.
The goal of this page is to demonstrate how marketing data can be used to understand audience behavior, engagement, and performance trends.



A dashboard helps marketers quickly understand what is working and what needs improvement. For this project, I focused on simple performance indicators that could be useful in a campaign or digital marketing setting.







Metric
What It Shows




Engagement
How much the audience interacts with content


Reach
How many people saw the campaign or post


Audience Interest
What type of content performs best


Performance Trend
Whether results improved or decreased over time







Based on the sample analysis, content that feels more personal, visual, and community-focused tends to create stronger engagement. This matters because marketing is not just about posting content, but about understanding what the audience responds to.





Quarto

R

ggplot2

Excel

Data Visualization

Marketing Analytics





This dashboard helped me practice turning information into visuals and short insights. It also helped me understand how marketers can use data to make better campaign decisions.

title: Google Analytics
text:
This page highlights my understanding of Google Analytics and how it connects to digital marketing strategy.
Google Analytics helps marketers understand how users find, visit, and interact with websites. It can be used to measure traffic, engagement, conversions, and audience behavior.



Google Analytics is important because it helps marketers make decisions based on data instead of guessing. It can show which pages are getting attention, where visitors are coming from, and what content is helping reach marketing goals.





Understanding website traffic

Measuring user engagement

Identifying audience behavior

Evaluating campaign performance

Connecting data to marketing strategy








Term
Meaning




Users
People who visit the website


Sessions
Visits to the website


Engagement Rate
How often users interact with the site


Traffic Source
Where visitors came from


Conversions
Important actions users complete







For my portfolio, Google Analytics connects to the goal of understanding how visitors interact with my website. This can help me improve the site, strengthen my personal brand, and make the portfolio more useful for future employers.




Learning Google Analytics helps me connect marketing strategy with measurable results. It also shows that I can think beyond creative ideas and understand how performance is tracked.
